rules: Synthetic values must be explicitly declared and provenance-marked (scenario/config-driven).
No synthetic value may be relabeled as measured or site truth.
Default values must be scenario/config inputs, not hidden magic constants that affect behavior.
Unknown plant parameters stay unknown (never represented as real plant data).
LogicalOnly behavior may use logical/state-transition/reference behavior only; no fabricated physics.
FirstOrderReady behavior may use only the minimum first-order behavior supported by current evidence plus explicit synthetic assumptions.
